tagline: Minimalist productivity app focused on deep work, task management, and focus analytics.

details.overview: FocusFlow is a full-stack productivity application designed to help users stay focused using Pomodoro-based work sessions, task tracking, analytics, and distraction-free workflows. The app focuses on clean UI, smooth UX, and practical productivity features with scalable backend architecture.
key_features: Pomodoro focus timer with session tracking
what_i_learned: Designed and built a scalable full-stack architecture using React, Express, Prisma, and PostgreSQL
Implemented secure authentication using JWT and Google OAuth
Built RESTful APIs with proper route structure and middleware
Managed relational database models using Prisma ORM
Improved frontend state management and application structure
Optimized user experience with responsive UI and clean component architecture
Handled deployment workflows using Vercel, Render, and Neon PostgreSQL
Built production-style project organization and backend architecture
